text:
Maria (PM): heads-up — we plan to cut SDK v4.2.0 in ~48h. main bullets: windows arm64 runtime support, a tweak to the default retry/backoff behavior, and a docs snippet schema shift (we're standardizing snippets as small JSON-LD objects). also flagging the legacy sync-client default for deprecation; migration guide will go live today.

Jake (Eng): is the retry/backoff tweak a breaking change? do customers need to edit code or config?

Maria (PM): not a code-breaking API change, but it changes default timing. we bumped the base backoff and added jitter to reduce thundering bursts. most integrations won't need edits, but high-throughput producers that relied on very tight retries should test. opt-out with env var: `REDWOOD_RETRY_MODE=legacy` or set explicit retry config.

Suren (Docs): I'll draft the migration guide and a short before/after snippet for each SDK (py/js/go). for the snippets switch: we want snippets published as `{"format":"snippet","lang":"py","code":"..."}` so our docs site can render alt formats and copy-to-clipboard reliably. any objections?

Elaine (DevEx): no objections. that schema will help the playground too. timeline: can you land the guide + examples by EOD so I can wire changelog and release notes?

Maria (PM): yes, target EOD. include a short FAQ on why arm64 support matters (cost + perf) and a note about telemetry — we're keeping telemetry opt-in as-is.

Jake (Eng): CI/packaging notes: windows-arm64 wheel builds are in the pipeline but installers will be behind a feature flag for the first week. also adding a small compatibility test that toggles `REDWOOD_RETRY_MODE`.

eng-bot: CI build 4.2.0-windows-arm64 started — logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4821 (proc 1/3)

Suren (Docs): draft added to docs repo under /changes/sdk-4.2-migration.md. snips: python, js, go, and a curl example. copied the `REDWOOD_RETRY_MODE` examples.

docs-bot: changelog PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/212 (contains snippet schema notes + migration steps)

Elaine (DevEx): I'll prepare the release checklist: announcement, release notes, sample app update, migration tweet/thread, and help-center article. also scheduling a short office hours for users who hit issues next week.

Jake (Eng): quick note on the deprecation: "legacy sync-client default" — we will not remove library code now, only flip the default in 6 months. customers can pin behavior using the env var or explicit client constructor flag. include that timeline in the guide.

Maria (PM): good. timeline in guide: default flip in ~6 months, reminder emails at 90/30/7 days. rolling rollout for windows-arm64 builds beginning tomorrow.

Suren (Docs): adding a small migration snippet: ```py
# before
client = RedwoodClient(sync=True)
# after
client = RedwoodClient(sync=False)  # opt into async default
```

Jake (Eng): tiny nit: make sure examples show `await client.generate(...)` when switching to async.

Suren (Docs): will do.

Maria (PM): thanks team — ping me if anything blocks. i'll post a short all-hands note once release is cut. :rocket:
